description:
First public Dual VoT release based on stable Morphe Patches 1.37.0.

Highlights:
- Google/other and Yandex voice-over translation in one patch bundle.
- Separate player buttons with mutual exclusion and automatic reset on video changes.
- Reliable Yandex requests for previously untranslated videos using validated audio uploads.
- Original audio remains unchanged while Yandex generates a translation and is reduced only when translated playback starts.
- Fine 1% controls and 5% slider steps for the built-in translation settings.

Tested with YouTube 21.26.360. See CHANGELOG.md for full details and attribution.
